content: You will be automatically redirected to the {{sectionName}} section in 5 seconds.

comment.text: This is a message displayed to the user, informing them that they will be automatically redirected to another section of the application. The `{{sectionName}}` variable will be replaced with the name of the section they are being redirected to (e.g., "AI Agents").

usage.context:
<EmptyView
 title={t("Common:NoAccessAIAgentTitle", {
 aiAgent: t("Common:AIAgent", { defaultValue: "AI Agent" }),
 defaultValue: "You don't have access to this {{aiAgent}}",
 })}
 description={t("Common:AIAgentAccessRedirectNote", {
 sectionName: t("Common:AIAgents", { defaultValue: "AI Agents" }),
 defaultValue: "Redirecting to {{sectionName}}...",
 })}
 icon={
 isBase ? <ManageAccessRightsLightIcon /> : <ManageAccessRightsDarkIcon />
